conbody.p: This feature dynamically represents the vehicle’s lights for a certain period of time when the driver unlocks the vehicle, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsHeadlight time-out on the infotainment system screen. Dynamic welcome light will turn on for approximately 2 seconds.
